text: Only I—” He pushed his plate away, rose from his chair, and walked around the table to her side. She started up with frightened eyes. “Ethan, there’s something wrong! I knew there was!” She seemed to melt against him in her terror, and he caught her in his arms, held her fast there, felt her lashes beat his cheek like netted butterflies. “What is it—what is it?” she stammered; but he had found her lips at last and was drinking unconsciousness of everything but the joy they gave him.
